schema:name: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Silicate Glass LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Liu et al. 2025 (GCA 393) Experimental silicate glass Spot analysis ns-LA-Q-ICP-MS Guangzhou Inst. Geochemistry (column V of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: State Key Laboratory of Isotope Geochemistry, Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS, China

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy mount (experimental capsule half-section)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Experimental capsule longitudinally sectioned with wire saw; half mounted in epoxy for analysis
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system)
ada:ablationDurationPerSpotDefault: ~40 s (inferred from typical CetacAnalyte HE protocol for glass)
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He (flow rate not stated; carrier gas with N₂ or Ar mixed for sensitivity optimization)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: NIST 610 as primary standard measured in session; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards; unknowns bracketed by standards
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element from EMP: Si (SiO₂ from EMP for silicate glass); NIST 610 as external standard
ada:internalStandardElement: Si from EMP (SiO₂ wt% for silicate glass)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Si IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-resolved LA-ICP-MS signal inspected; micronuggets identified from spikes in Au signal and excluded from integration to obtain smooth signals (verified by Fig. 1 in paper)
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST 610 (primary external standard; Jochum et al. 2011); Si from EMP as IS
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (monitoring standards measured in same sessions)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Ablation Cell Type
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Cetac Analyte HE system (stated as the laser ablation system coupled to Agilent 7900)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: N₂ or Ar mixed into He carrier for sensitivity optimization (amounts not stated)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Drift Monitor Frequency
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: NIST 610 as primary; NIST 612 and BCR-2G as monitoring standards

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Single spot per location (~40 s ablation at 7 Hz)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes in time-resolved spectra; excluded from integration (smooth signals = fully dissolved Au; Fig. 1 shows this criterion)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS (Si from EMP)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Additional Notes
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Analysis of quenched experimental glasses from high-pressure (1 GPa) piston-cylinder experiments; Au and Cu solubility measurements; smooth time-resolved signals indicate fully dissolved Au (no micronuggets)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
